The build and package steps use standard Rust compilation and `install` operations into `${pkgdir}`, including application binaries, systemd/DBus metadata, desktop files, icons, and the license. There is no evidence of obfuscation, exfiltration, reverse shells, credential access, unexpected system modification, or execution of downloaded code.
</details>
